description: Gives the artwork setup for a 4OVER4 print file: size, bleed, safe margin, 300 DPI, CMYK and file formats such as PDF; use it when someone asks how to set up a file for printing. For arithmetic at a custom size use calculate_print_bleed. The product slug is optional: with it the result uses that product's default size, without it the general setup. Customer phrases: "file requirements for business cards", "how do I set up my flyer file".

productSlug.description: Product slug, from the slug field of a show_products, recommend or find_similar_products result, e.g. standard-business-cards.

name: get_print_file_setup

data.description: One product's file setup, or the general setup.

link.description: The page on www.4over4.com to continue on: order, upload and checkout happen there.
